definition: I. [ נָוָה ] verb only Hiph`il (si vera lectio) literally beautify (then connected with נאה be comely , so Buhl SS ; compare Late Hebrew נוה Niph`al shew oneself beautiful , Nithp. adorn oneself , נָוֶה adjective beautiful , Levy NHWB ); — Imperfect 1 singular suffix אַנְוֵהוּ Exod 15:2 I will beautify, adorn him (with praises; object ׳ י ; || רומם ; ᵐ5 δυξάσω , ᵑ7 glorificabo ). — adjective נָוָה Jer 6:2 , see נָאוֶה below [ נָאָה ].

I. [נָוָה] verb only Hiph`il (si vera lectio) literally beautify (then connected with נאה be comely, so Buhl SS; compare Late Hebrew נוה Niph`al shew oneself beautiful, Nithp. adorn oneself, נָוֶה adjective beautiful, LevyNHWB); — Imperfect 1 singular suffix אַנְוֵהוּ Exod 15:2 I will beautify, adorn him (with praises; object ׳י; || רומם; ᵐ5 δυξάσω, ᵑ7 glorificabo). — adjective נָוָה Jer 6:2, see נָאוֶה below [נָאָה].
